definition: NEISO 2020+2021 VALIDATION TOUCHPOINTS (rule 22 validation tier; freeze scope = locked_test only since the 2026-08-26 owner ruling). Byte-faithful replay of the 2026-08-17-neiso-99-joint-p1 keeper recipe on the two never-before-solved validation rungs. Frozen recipe, zero deltas: no parameter was tuned for, against, or in response to 2020 or 2021. The neiso-92 (2026-08-13) data-readiness REFUSAL of 2021 is OVERTAKEN: all four inputs it graded DEGRADED now carry per-year 2019-2025 coverage (nuclear-availability-NEISO.csv, NUCLEAR_MONTHLY_CF_BY_YEAR, IMPORT/EXPORT_TRANCHES_BY_YEAR, eia860_chp_by_year, parasitic_load_factors). ITERABLE model-SELECTION evidence, NEVER a certified out-of-sample skill number.

holdout.tierCaveat: Validation tier: ITERABLE model-SELECTION evidence. This is NOT a certified out-of-sample skill number and must never be quoted as one. THE RUN COVERS TWO RUNGS AND THEY DIVERGE — read `perYear`, not the single determination: 2021 scores CALIBRATED standalone with every criterion passing, and the run-level NOT-YET is driven entirely by 2020's C3a. The panel's criterion table is stamped on 2020, the year that carries the degradation. Neither rung is spent: the validation tier is re-runnable by design, which is what makes the rule-22 touchpoint loop (diagnose -> re-train on 2023-2025 -> re-test) legal. The touch-once locked test (2019 / H1-2026) is NOT spent here and NEISO has never been granted it.
holdout.envelopeCaveat: SAME-ENVELOPE PARITY: 2020 and 2021 are built from the SAME uniform 2018-2026 CAMPD detector pass as the tuned years, carry the same merit-order guard, and sit in family on window count and MW-days (2020 401 windows / 2021 373 vs a 2023-2025 range of 260-338 on a declining fleet). The residual over-count that keeps the locked-test freeze active is therefore baked into the tuned years too: hold both sides' ABSOLUTE levels at arm's length, but the in-sample-to-holdout DELTA this table reports is measured like-for-like. TWO STATED LIMITS ON THE COMPARISON, neither of which the panel hides: (i) the keeper's in-sample column was solved at git b7904a1 (2026-08-17) and these rungs at 6619fb4a (2026-09-05) -- 26 solve kwargs were added in between, each verified in this bundle's calibration_attestation.json to sit at its ScenarioConfig default, but no same-HEAD in-sample control has been registered; (ii) the bench parts for 2020/2021 were written by the builder at HEAD while NEISO's 2022-2025 parts predate it (fingerprint b2f21b9a00d3), so C1's metered actuals are not on a single builder vintage across the span.
